description: issue #693 (review-gate follow-up): `rest`'s duration MUST be a number; a non-number argument (here the word "soon") raises `ol-type` at runtime with expected:"number", actual:"word", operation:"rest" (spec/interaction-events.md's `rest` section lists both `ol-type` and `ol-range`; spec/error-model.md). No `sound` event is emitted. The instruction event is still emitted for the statement before the diagnostic halts it. This is the type-error counterpart to `rest-range-error`, completing `rest`'s negative-fixture coverage.
